name: x1_adaptive_budget
label: EXPLORATORY / post-hoc simulation on logged training-time rollouts; not a pre-registered test

protocol.regret: max_c H(c) - H(pick); H = held-out success (25 episodes)
protocol.recommendation_rule: max Beta(1,1) posterior mean on observed (judge) outcomes, random tie-break
protocol.episode_order: paired: one random permutation of pool seeds per repetition, shared by all checkpoints
protocol.judge_noise_ftype: FPR_c = q_c*FPR_dropped + (1-q_c)*FPR_other, q_c = P(dropped|fail) from eval rollouts (hi if checkpoint pool success >= 0.6), all rates Beta-posterior draws per repetition
protocol.judge_noise: per-episode flips with P(judge success|true fail)=FPR, P(judge fail|true success)=FNR; per-repetition FPR/FNR ~ Beta(1+k,1+n-k) from eval JSONL, task-specific; _pessimistic = Wilson 95% upper bounds; cascade = local AND nebius
protocol.ci: percentile bootstrap over repetitions (episode orderings / judge draws); mean_over_runs CI from independent per-run bootstraps
